description: Expander for the Performance Mixer, placed immediately to its left, adding a stereo direct output and a mute gate input for each channel, and an aux control voltage input for each stereo channel

inputs.text: A gate of 2V or more here mutes that channel of the mixer
Sets that stereo channel's aux send on the mixer, full to X at -5V, nothing at 0V and full to Y at 5V

outputs.text: The left side of that channel of the mixer, taken after its fader
The right side of that channel of the mixer, taken after its fader

notes: the expander does nothing on its own: it must be placed immediately to the left of a Performance Mixer, which is the module it adds these jacks to.
